## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 295 captures during May 2021. Activity was completed as part of the clinic’s routine service and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures reported below. The capture total is reported for the site and month specified.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 9 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.1%. The result indicates that most images were suitable for assessment, while the ungradable images should continue to be monitored through routine quality review. Staff raised no new equipment faults during the month.

## Grading

There were 55 referable results during May 2021. The median grading lag was 1 day. This measure reflects the time taken for grading and should be considered alongside the site’s overall activity and image-quality results. Routine monitoring of grading timeliness remains appropriate to support consistent reporting and timely follow-up.
